provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 1100 W SADOSA ST, EASTLAND, TX, 76448

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: 2 caregivers at the operation did not have valid CPR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: An unlocked cabinet in the shared restroom that is accessible to children in care contained cleaning supplies. This was corrected at inspection when the cabinet was locked bringing the operation into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Posting of Activity Plan: The operation did not have a daily schedule or acitivity plan posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting of Activity Plan (26 TAC §746.2209)

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: An allergy plan for a child that has a diagnosed food allergy to corn was not signed by the parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: Sign in and out sheets for the operation had been recorded for the week of 2/24/2025. This was corrected at inspection when the operation filled out sign in sheets for the week bringing the operation into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Cots for 6 children were not labeled. This was corrected at inspection when the operation labeled the cots bringing the operation into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The changing table observed had a dead roach with roach droppings on the surface. This was corrected at inspection when the operation sanitized the changing table bringing the operation into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list: The operation has not validated their employee list since 8/29/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list (26 TAC §745.651(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: One employee file out of four audited did not have a GED/High School Diploma, photo ID/driver's license, or background check eligibility letter.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving: Two former employees were not inactivated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))

occurrences.finding: Inspection of Sprinkler System: The last fire alarm system inspection documented was for 5/3/22.  A current fire alarm system was not available for CCR to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspection of Sprinkler System (26 TAC §746.5309)

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Maintained: The liability insurance date listed in the provider portal expired in 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Maintained (26 TAC §746.201(8))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Infants in care were observed eating lunch in their highchairs.  They were not secured with safety straps.  This was corrected during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Controlling Person - Submit Controlling Person Form to Licensing within two days after a person becomes a controlling person. See TAC 745.901: A governing body member was not added as a controlling person within 2 days.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Controlling Person - Submit Controlling Person Form to Licensing within two days after a person becomes a controlling person. See TAC 745.901 (26 TAC §745.903(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Providing & Applying Insect Repellant and Sunscreen: The operational policies and procedures were audited during the inspection.  The operation was missing policies for applying insect repellent/sunscreen, gang free zone, emergency preparedness plan, making accommodations for children with special needs, and employee vaccinations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Providing & Applying Insect Repellant and Sunscreen (26 TAC §746.501(a)(19))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 5 children records were audited.  3 of the 5 did not have current immunization records or a current affidavit of exemption.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: 4 personnel files were audited.  4 personnel files were missing the date of hire.  1 personnel file was missing proof of background check eligibility or submission.  4 files were missing an employee acknowledgment of the operation policies and procedures.  4 files were missing proof of orientation.  4 files were missing a copy of either a photo ID or driver's license.  4 files were missing a copy of high school diploma/GED.  4 files were missing a notarized affidavit required by HHS.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Director's Certificate: The operation did not have a director's certificate available for review.  The director stated she did not have one.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Director's Certificate (26 TAC §746.801(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: A bathroom utilized by children in care presented with an odor of urine.  The bathroom utilized by children in care was not clean.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Training files observed were lacking required training in required topics. Furthermore, one caregiver's file was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: CPR certifications that were observed were taken online and do not meet the requirements of minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver in the toddler classroom was present at the operation before receiving notice from the CBCU regarding the their eligibility.     This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver left the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
